methods.description: Retain the actually executed new check-sources.py and exception-selector author programs once under source-investigation-v1/author-programs, with their original hashes, outputs, input inventories, runtimes and fixed-path limits. The prior source probe checked complete original family identity and Shapely covers at authenticated native centres for ten North Maluku targets; it did not execute the shared ImmutableReader or native/physical authority. Custom per-file/decoded-size and RSS checks were used; complete pre-admission through Baseline/NewVintage, hermetic runtime, two-run reproducibility and portable replay are not established. Individual xb result writes and later static gzip packaging do not retroactively establish complete producer destination or phase admission. Classification follows the accepted Myeik native-cell counting workflow: source-centre membership and discrete native interval counts, with no geodesic area/distance measurement. Required geometry-domain review remains declared by issue #1884.
methods.software: Original recorded Python 3.12.14; Shapely 2.1.2; GEOS 3.13.1; NumPy 2.3.5. Interpreter/dependency binary identities unbound. Preparation uses Node 24.19.0/Python standard-library metadata only.
methods.units: Native cells and source features; seconds and bytes. Native-centre longitude/latitude predicate, no area/distance inference.

methods.description: Data-only retained JSON/hash/identity/half-open interval and source-citation inspection for all 21 conflict intervals. Existing outcome contains the author procedural assertions and their limits; there is no retained executable analytical producer or GIS/native reproduction claim. Actual 27 held cells and competitors are bound to the full frozen selector, accepted source/owner records and unchanged current-ownership receipt. Independent substantive inspection remains required.
methods.software: Recorded standard-library JSON/hash/identity/interval inspection; exact standalone analytical runtime/executable capture unavailable.
methods.units: Native cells, intervals, stable location/source identities and locality cohorts.

methods.description: Preserve exact Papua/West Papua selector rows, source/parent/topology context and current-ownership references. Earlier inline exploratory analysis was not captured as immutable executable code. The preservation writer is retained as literal JSON data in consumed-inputs.json; it is not a claimed replay or native/GIS execution. The Merauke conflict cell overlaps the separate 27-cell conflict scope and is counted once in whole-session accounting. Original part-10/part-19 consumed locators at nonancestor ffa32416 remain verbatim in the preserved Papua records. The manifest authenticates accepted f7c3583 retained aliases only after complete ordinary mode/OID/byte/SHA equality; decoded identity equals plain JSON body identity. This is explicit byte custody, not an original-ancestry or new-computation claim.
methods.software: Recorded JSON/metadata inspection and standard-library preservation; analytical runtime/code custody limited as documented.
methods.units: Native cells, intervals and stable location/source identities; literal ring counts are diagnostic holds, not qualified territorial exclusions.

methods.description: Retain the actual unchanged physical-reproduction.py/comparison.py execution, original runtime identity and complete recorded source receipts for ten whole North Maluku targets. GEOS source-relative set/coverage and hierarchy witnesses support categorical native-interval disposition; no new geodesic area/distance measurement is claimed. This preparation authenticates compact accepted index/helper aliases and actual results without repeating the larger source/GIS phase. Two target reconstruction issues remain held; 10,185 issue-free physical candidate cells still require native interpretation.
